It is known for Lebanese and Turkish cuisine, such as cold mezze and grill dishes, and offers comfortable outdoor seating in pleasant weather. Open daily from 12 noon until around midnight (until 1 am on Thursdays and Fridays). Contact: 0534896665.

98073247.s: Al Bustan is one of the best restaurants serving Lebanese food in Al Baha, with a wide and varied selection of tasty Lebanese dishes. It has an elegant two-floor design and a warm atmosphere suited to the cool weather. Open daily from 12 noon to 12:30 am. Contact: 0177241007.

98073245.s: Sol Restaurant and Cafe has a design inspired by Andalusian heritage, set over two floors with indoor and outdoor seating and parking. The cafe offers a varied dessert menu. It is known for Italian dishes such as pizza and risotto, and the complex also includes a flower shop. Open daily from 7 am until around midnight (from 12:30 pm on Fridays). Contact: 0508800004.

98073242.s: Al Dawsiyah Farm is the largest aromatic plant farm in the Kingdom and the first farm in Saudi Arabia specialized in producing medicinal and aromatic plants. It is known for medicinal and aromatic plants, organic products and moringa products (Arabian and Indian), and also grows many other crops such as mango, lemon, sesame and apples. All of its products are organic, from the plant through to the harvested crop. Open daily from 6 am to 7 pm. Contact: 0555702987.

98073240.t: Basateen Al Loz Farm and Cabins
98073240.s: Basateen Al Loz Farm and Cabins reflect the unspoiled rural environment of the Al Baha region. Visitors can stroll through the farm and see its trees and produce, including almonds, figs and grapes. The farm has wooden cabins, each with two rooms and full facilities, as well as a cafe serving traditional breakfast, pizza and drinks, water pools with fountains, and a garden with birds and small animals. Activities include walking around the farm and staying in the cabins. Facilities include a prayer room, restrooms, a bird cabin, a cafe and seating areas. Open daily from 6 am to 10:30 am and from 3 pm to 9 pm. Contact: 0550785152.

98073239.s: The first tourist farm in Saudi Arabia accredited by the Ministry of Tourism. The farm lets visitors stroll its grounds and enjoy the natural terraces, crops and recreational facilities in a family atmosphere with warm hospitality, making it one of the best tourist destinations in the southern region and in Al Baha in particular. Activities include olive presses, a bird garden, a butterfly garden, a strawberry farm, breakfast, Al Zaytuna shops, Al Zaytuna Cave, horse riding and archery. There is also a mosque, restrooms and residential units. Open Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Contact: 0552732870.

98073234.s: Al Aed Lodge reflects the heritage and history of the region and the traditions of generosity and hospitality, and displays a collection of important antiques and old tools from Bani Kabir Governorate. Activities include a tour of the lodge introducing the heritage of the ancestors and the history of the area, hospitality and traditional meals, and performances by a folk troupe. It is known for serving an authentic local Saudi breakfast, and a homemade dinner experience can be booked in advance. Contact: 0544752231.

98073224.s: Al Shawlah Waterfall is an unspoiled natural site in Bani Hassan Governorate that appeals to adventure lovers. Reaching it requires a four-wheel-drive vehicle and a walk of moderate difficulty. It is one of the largest sources of flowing water in the Al Baha region and attracts campers who stay for several days beside its calm, refreshing stream.

98073222.s: Ain Al Jamal Waterfall is a beautiful, clean natural site in Bani Hassan Governorate. A four-wheel-drive vehicle is recommended for easy access. It is a destination whose visitors enjoy its peaceful atmosphere and stunning natural scenery.

98073221.s: Al Sharashir is one of the largest waterfalls in the Al Baha region, and its two slopes make it a distinctive sight. A four-wheel-drive or high-clearance vehicle is recommended for getting close, or you can park and walk to it. Note that no services are available at the site.

98073220.s: Safa Al Buraq Waterfall is a long natural site resembling a watercourse, stretching through the countryside of Al Baha city. The flow varies with the season, and it is best visited right after rainfall to enjoy it at its most beautiful. Please keep the site clean.

98073219.s: Umm Al Daqiq Waterfall is an enchanting natural site, especially beautiful after rainfall and surrounded by dense trees. Reaching it takes some effort because of the nature of the road, but the beauty of the place and its surroundings makes the visit worthwhile. Please keep the site clean to preserve its beauty for those who come after you.

98073218.s: Al Ghadeer Waterfall is described as one of the most beautiful waterfalls in the Al Baha region, set in a remote area amid enchanting greenery. Reaching it requires driving a relatively long distance on a dirt road. Because of the remote location and limited services, it suits adventurous young visitors better than families.

98073217.s: Al Hamdah Waterfall is a rare sight in the Kingdom, with dense greenery all around and a small waterfall. The sound of water flowing through the stream and into the valley brings a feeling of calm. The place is beautiful and has wide areas to sit and spend a pleasant time with family. Children can play in the water and watch village scenes, including ducks and ducklings swimming along the stream.

98073216.s: Wadi Turabah Zahran is considered one of the largest valleys on the Arabian Peninsula, with a length of more than 330 km. This makes it a prominent geographic landmark in Al Mandaq Governorate that attracts nature lovers and fans of wide open spaces.

98073215.s: One of the best-known valleys in the Al Baha region, in Al Mandaq Governorate, with an excellent location. The valley is surrounded by pomegranate orchards, for which the area is famous. Its water flows all year round until it reaches the well-known Madhaj Dam, and it is one of the best places to spend an enjoyable time.

It has shaded seating, walkways, children's play areas and supply kiosks, and features waterfalls and natural and artificial lakes fed from the top of the mountain. Open daily from 7 am to 2 am.

It has dense vegetation and trees, flowing waterfalls and water pools surrounded by striking rock formations, as well as camping areas, and combines the beauty of long-lived trees such as juniper and olive. Open all day, with supply kiosks.

98073209.s: Al Khalab Park sits on a high hill with wide views over Al Mandaq Governorate and the surrounding valleys and mountains. It has sections of green lawns, walking paths, waterfalls and a stream running through the middle of the park, and includes caves, adding to its enchanting beauty and unique experience. Open all day, with cafes and Al Burj Restaurant.
